name: rosetta-sum-to-100

use default
use System.Text.StringBuilder

let joined = 2
let minus = 1

expressions() -> Pipe[(value: int, text: string)] is
    for code in 0..19683 do
        let operators = LIST(9)
        let rest mut = code

        for _ in 0..9 do
            operators.add(rest % 3)

            rest = rest / 3
        od

        if operators[0] == joined then
            continue
        fi

        let text = StringBuilder()

        let total mut = 0
        let term mut = 0
        let sign mut = 1

        for at in 0..9 do
            let digit = at + 1

            if operators[at] == joined then
                term = term * 10 + digit
            else
                total = total + sign * term
                sign = if operators[at] == minus then -1 else 1 fi
                term = digit

                if at == 0 then
                    if operators[at] == minus then
                        text.append("-")
                    fi
                else
                    text.append(if operators[at] == minus then " - " else " + " fi)
                fi
            fi

            text.append(digit)
        od

        yield (value = total + sign * term, text = text.to_string())
    od
si

let all = expressions() |> collect()

write_line("expressions summing to 100:")

all
    |> filter(expression => expression.value == 100)
    |> sort((left, right) => left.text <> right.text)
    |> each(expression => write_line("    {expression.text}"))

let counts = MAP()

for expression in all do
    let seen mut = 0

    counts.try_get_value(expression.value, seen ref)

    counts[expression.value] = seen + 1
od

let most = counts.keys |> max_by(value => counts[value])

assert most? else "some sum has the most expressions"

write_line("")
write_line("{most} has the most expressions, {counts[most]} of them")

let unreachable = stream(1, sum => sum || sum + 1)
    |> filter(sum => !counts.contains_key(sum))
    |> first()

assert unreachable? else "some positive sum has no expression"

write_line("{unreachable} is the lowest positive sum with no expression")

let highest = counts.keys |> sort((left, right) => right - left) |> take(10)

write_line("ten highest sums: {highest |> join(", ")}")
